included: Study-level or predefined-subset counts and two-by-two tables only.
excluded: All participant/specimen/family IDs, case rows, variant-level records, clinical text, source locators and private paths.
restriction: The public subset cannot reconstruct original source extraction, record-level inclusion, or deduplication.
